title: "Virome library — Figure 1A"

## Overview

Three-panel figure reproducing the Seo et al. 2023 *Cell* Fig. 1A layout.

| Panel | X axis | Grey bar | Coloured bar |
|-------|--------|----------|--------------|
| 1 | Accession count | In RppH-only input (≥1 R replicate) | Detected with ≥ `MIN_REPS` Xrn1 replicates passing |
| 2 | Feature length (nt) | — | 3′UTR (orange) + intergenic (blue) boxplots |
| 3 | Accessions detected | — | Stacked: 2 vs 3 replicates passing |

**Sample identity:**

- **R1 / R2 / R3** = RppH-only treatment = **no Xrn1 degradation** = input / control
- **X1 / X2 / X3** = Xrn1 treatment = **degradation** = experimental output

**Filtering applied to Panel 1 (output) and Panel 3:**  
A peak is *passing* in a replicate when `peak_pass_RN == TRUE`, which requires:

- `adj_sf ≥ 0.3` (stall fraction above threshold)
- `stall_reads ≥ 10` (minimum read support)
- `qvalue ≤ 0.01` (significance)

`n_reps_passing` counts replicates meeting all three criteria.  
The peaks CSV contains **all scored peaks** (passing and failing) — the filter
`n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS` is applied inside this script.

**Alignment:** BAM files from `04_align/fs4`
(renamed `20260312_viromelib_150x0_fs4-prev`).  
**Input CSV** generated by `scripts/accession_presence_by_sample.py`.

---

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)

# ── Config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
INPUT_DIR     <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/inputs"

FASTA_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "pilot_library_20260319.uniqueIDs.fa")
CSV_FILE      <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "virus_stats.csv")
PRESENCE_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "accession_presence_by_sample.csv")
PEAKS_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "123_peaks_annotated.csv")

OUT_DIR       <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1"
OUT_FIGURE    <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_style.pdf")
OUT_CSV       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "virome_summary.csv")
OUT_DET       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "detection_summary.csv")

MIN_REPS     <- 2      # n_reps_passing threshold to call an accession detected
MIN_LEN      <- 100    # minimum feature length (nt) for Panel 2
BAR_WIDTH    <- 0.7
POINT_ALPHA  <- 0.35
FIGURE_W     <- 14
FIGURE_H     <- 8.5
```

---

## 1. Parse FASTA — feature lengths

```{r parse_fasta}
lines   <- readLines(FASTA_FILE)
headers <- sub("^>", "", lines[startsWith(lines, ">")])
rx      <- "^([^|]+)\\|(\\d+)-(\\d+)_(.+)$"
matched <- regmatches(headers, regexec(rx, headers))

parse_one <- function(m) {
  if (length(m) < 5) return(NULL)
  data.frame(acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", m[2]),
             length    = as.integer(m[4]) - as.integer(m[3]),
             feature   = m[5], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
fasta_df <- bind_rows(lapply(matched, parse_one))

utr_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("3UTR", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

ig_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("intergenic", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

message(glue("{nrow(utr_df)} 3'UTR | {nrow(ig_df)} intergenic entries >= {MIN_LEN} nt"))
```

---

## 2. Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy}
artifact_phyla <- c("Macronovirus", "Tobacco albetovirus 3")

tax_df <- read_csv(CSV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    phylum    = if_else(phylum %in% artifact_phyla | is.na(phylum) |
                          phylum == "Unannotated", "Unannotated", phylum),
    family    = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "Unannotated",
                        "Unannotated", family)
  )
```

---

## 3. Input — RppH-only accessions (R replicates, no degradation)

Accessions present in ≥1 R replicate define the sequenced input.
R = RppH-only = no Xrn1 degradation = control.

```{r input}
presence <- read_csv(PRESENCE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean  = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    in_r_input = R1 | R2 | R3    # present in any RppH-only (control) replicate
  )

input_accs <- presence %>% filter(in_r_input) %>% pull(acc_clean)
message(glue("{length(input_accs)} accessions present in >= 1 RppH-only (R) replicate"))

input_counts <- tibble(acc_clean = input_accs) %>%
  inner_join(tax_df, by = "acc_clean") %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_input = n_distinct(acc_clean),
    phylum  = names(sort(table(phylum), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

---

## 4. Output — detected accessions (Xrn1, ≥ MIN_REPS passing)

The peaks CSV contains **all scored peaks** including failures.
`n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS` is the detection threshold applied here.

```{r detection}
peaks_raw <- read_csv(PEAKS_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_reps_passing), n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", sub("\\|.*", "", accession)),
    family    = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "Unannotated",
                        "Unannotated", family),
    rep_label = factor(n_reps_passing,
                       levels = c(2, 3),
                       labels = c("2 replicates", "3 replicates"))
  )

message(glue(
  "{nrow(peaks_raw)} peaks passing filter | ",
  "{n_distinct(peaks_raw$acc_clean)} unique accessions | ",
  "{n_distinct(peaks_raw$family)} families"
))

# One row per accession: take highest n_reps_passing
det_summary <- peaks_raw %>%
  group_by(family, acc_clean) %>%
  summarise(n_reps = max(n_reps_passing), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rep_label = factor(n_reps, levels = c(2, 3),
                            labels = c("2 replicates", "3 replicates"))) %>%
  group_by(family, rep_label) %>%
  summarise(n_accs = n(), .groups = "drop")

output_counts <- det_summary %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(n_output = sum(n_accs), .groups = "drop")

det_wide <- det_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rep_label, values_from = n_accs, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total_detected = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))
write_csv(det_wide, OUT_DET)
message(glue("Detection summary -> {OUT_DET}"))
```

---

## 5. Combined family summary

```{r family_summary}
family_sum <- input_counts %>%
  left_join(output_counts, by = "family") %>%
  replace_na(list(n_output = 0))

write_csv(family_sum, OUT_CSV)

n_phyla <- n_distinct(family_sum$phylum[family_sum$phylum != "Unannotated"])
message(glue(
  "{sum(family_sum$n_input)} input | {sum(family_sum$n_output)} detected | ",
  "{nrow(family_sum)} families | {n_phyla} phyla"
))
```

## 6. Feature lengths joined to taxonomy

```{r feature_lengths}
utr_joined <- utr_df %>%
  inner_join(tax_df %>% select(acc_clean, family), by = "acc_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(family))

ig_joined <- ig_df %>%
  inner_join(tax_df %>% select(acc_clean, family), by = "acc_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(family))
```

---

## 7. Colours and factor order

```{r colours_order}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Pisuviricota"    = "#4472C4",
  "Kitrinoviricota" = "#C9542A",
  "Lenarviricota"   = "#70AD47",
  "Unannotated"     = "#999999"
)
rep_colors <- c(
  "2 replicates" = "#969696",
  "3 replicates" = "#252525"
)
region_colors <- c("3\u2032 UTR" = "#E07B54", "Intergenic" = "#6BAED6")

phylum_rank <- c("Pisuviricota"=1,"Kitrinoviricota"=2,
                 "Lenarviricota"=3,"Unannotated"=99)

fam_plot <- family_sum %>%
  mutate(phylum_idx = coalesce(phylum_rank[phylum], 50L)) %>%
  arrange(phylum_idx, n_input) %>%
  mutate(family = fct_inorder(factor(family)))

fam_levels <- levels(fam_plot$family)
n_fam      <- length(fam_levels)

add_phylum <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels)) %>%
    left_join(fam_plot %>% select(family, phylum), by = "family") %>%
    filter(!is.na(family))
}

obs_utr  <- add_phylum(utr_joined) %>% mutate(region = "3\u2032 UTR")
obs_ig   <- add_phylum(ig_joined)  %>% mutate(region = "Intergenic")
obs_both <- bind_rows(obs_utr, obs_ig) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("3\u2032 UTR", "Intergenic")))
det_plot <- add_phylum(det_summary)
```

---

## 8. Shared theme

```{r theme}
theme_fig <- function(show_y = FALSE) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7.5) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = if (show_y)
                           element_text(size = 6.5, face = "italic",
                                        colour = "grey20", hjust = 1)
                         else element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40",
                                      margin = margin(t = 3)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 2, 4, 2)
  )
}
```

---

## 9. Panel 1 — input vs output

```{r panel1}
max_n <- max(fam_plot$n_input)

phylum_brackets <- fam_plot %>%
  mutate(yi = as.integer(family)) %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(y_lo  = min(yi) - 0.45, y_hi = max(yi) + 0.45,
            y_mid = mean(range(yi)), .groups = "drop")

p_count <- ggplot(fam_plot, aes(y = family)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_input),  fill = "grey78", width = BAR_WIDTH) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_output, fill = phylum), width = BAR_WIDTH,
           show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = phylum_brackets,
               aes(x = max_n * 1.06, xend = max_n * 1.06,
                   y = y_lo, yend = y_hi, colour = phylum),
               linewidth = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = phylum_brackets,
            aes(x = max_n * 1.20, y = y_mid, label = phylum, colour = phylum),
            angle = 90, size = 1.8, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_n * 1.28),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(4),
                     expand = expansion(0)) +
  labs(x = "Accessions (input / detected)", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = TRUE) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 0, 4, 4))
```

---

## 10. Panel 2 — feature length distributions

```{r panel2}
p_lengths <- ggplot(obs_both, aes(y = family, x = length, fill = region)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = region), outlier.shape = NA,
               width = BAR_WIDTH * 0.42, linewidth = 0.25,
               position = position_dodge(width = BAR_WIDTH),
               show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = region), shape = 16, size = 0.35, alpha = POINT_ALPHA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0.12,
                                             dodge.width = BAR_WIDTH),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                     breaks = c(0, 500, 1000, 1500),
                     labels = c("0", "500", "1,000", "1,500 nt"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = "Feature length (nt)", y = NULL) +
  guides(fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = region_colors,
                                                    alpha = 1, shape = NA)),
         colour = "none") +
  theme_fig(show_y = FALSE) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.45, "lines"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), colour = NA),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4)
  )
```

---

## 11. Panel 3 — detection by replicate reproducibility

```{r panel3}
p_detect <- ggplot(det_plot, aes(y = family, x = n_accs, fill = rep_label)) +
  geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep_colors, name = "Passing replicates",
                    guide  = guide_legend(title.position = "top",
                                          reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(4)) +
  labs(x = "Accessions detected", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = FALSE) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title         = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.45, "lines"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), colour = NA),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4)
  )
```

---

## 12. Assemble and save

```{r assemble, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plots <- cowplot::align_plots(p_count, p_lengths, p_detect,
                              align = "v", axis = "lr")

fig <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plots[[1]], plots[[2]], plots[[3]],
  nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1.1, 0.75)
)

final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    "+ssRNA virome library \u2014 family distribution, feature lengths, and detection",
    fontface = "bold", size = 9, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey10"),
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    glue(
      "{sum(family_sum$n_input)} accessions in RppH-only input  \u00b7  ",
      "{sum(family_sum$n_output)} detected (\u2265{MIN_REPS} Xrn1 replicates passing)  \u00b7  ",
      "{nrow(family_sum)} families  \u00b7  {n_phyla} phyla"),
    size = 7, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey45"),
  fig,
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    glue(
      "Panel 1: grey = accessions present in \u2265 1 RppH-only (R) replicate (input, no degradation); ",
      "colour = accessions with \u2265 {MIN_REPS} Xrn1-treated (X) replicates passing ",
      "(adj_sf \u2265 0.3, stall reads \u2265 10, qvalue \u2264 0.01). ",
      "Panel 2: 3\u2032UTR (orange) and intergenic (blue) feature lengths; ",
      "sequences < {MIN_LEN} nt excluded. ",
      "Panel 3: detected accessions stacked by replicate reproducibility. ",
      "All scored peaks filtered here to n_reps_passing \u2265 {MIN_REPS}."),
    size = 6, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey55"),
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.035, 0.028, 1, 0.06)
)

ggsave(OUT_FIGURE, final, width = FIGURE_W, height = FIGURE_H, device = cairo_pdf)
message("Figure    -> ", OUT_FIGURE)
message("Summary   -> ", OUT_CSV)
message("Detection -> ", OUT_DET)
```
